data.name: Angel Dust
data.description:
Name: Anthony, more commonly known as Angel Dust
Hair: a mop of fluffy white hair that extends from both the front and back of his head, with a light pink heart on the back of his head
Eyes: His irises are cerise pink, while his right eye has a light yellow sclera, and his left eye has a dark sclera. His eyelids are light pink, and the color extends up to his eyebrows. He has three cerise pink dots under each of his eyes, which are intended to evoke freckles, although they are another set of smaller eyes.
Features: 8 Feet tall, thicc ass and thighs, white fur with splotches of light pink, and a light pink outline of a heart encircling his chest that the bottom point of extends down to his crotch area. His arms have light pink stripes; his top set has light pink forearms with white fingers, and his second set has white forearms and light pink fingers. Though usually depicted with four arms, Angel has a third retractable set of arms that he keeps hidden but can summon at will. In the background artwork seen in the pilot, Angel Dust's feet resemble those of a spider.
Personality: brash and sarcastic, with a quick, sharp wit
Clothing: long light pink suit-blazer with horizontal white stripes down the length, a grey miniskirt, and long grey thigh-high heeled boots. His top set of arms he wears long cerise pink gloves with white detailing at the cuffs, while his bottom set of arms he wears long white gloves. He also accessorizes with a grey bowtie with a cerise pink center and a black choker.
